verification_report.summary: Correct under the expressly accepted inputs and the conditional exact existence/root assertion of prop:numa-radial-continuum. All 72 sequential deductions and five reference records pass. The weak flux argument justifies scalar semiconvexity, the fixed angular volume, convolution and bounded-product convergence, the jump mass formula, and continuity without discarding a possible Cantor derivative. Interior inversion and the contact-component argument then classify the slope. Exterior flux minima force positive horizontal coefficients; boundedness at the Fubini–Study end fixes the integration constant, and ordinary ODE uniqueness propagates the zero exterior slope. Canonical representatives and normalization give uniqueness among bounded K-invariant solutions. Accepted precompactness and identification of every cluster imply uniform convergence to the explicit C1,1 solution. No new outside PDE regularity theorem or all-solutions uniqueness is used. This verdict does not certify numa_radial_family_01; book inclusion still requires that audit to pass. Full report: results/numa_selected_limit_01/verification_report.md.
